title: Registration Rule for Appointment Scheduling: Check-In, Late Arrival, No-Show Marking and Riverbend Delays
content:
**Rule.** A patient with an **Appointment Scheduling** appointment at Riverbend Regional Health is checked in through the visit type's check-in methods. A patient arriving within the visit type's late-arrival grace minutes after the start is seen; later arrivals are handled under the visit type's late-arrival policy. An appointment not checked in by the visit type's no-show minutes after the start is marked no-show, unless Riverbend was running more than the visit type's Riverbend-delay minutes late and the patient left, which is recorded as a Riverbend cancellation instead. Check-in registers the hospital account for the visit.

## Appointment states around the visit

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| booked or confirmed | checked in | the patient arrives (or joins the video room) and is checked in; the hospital account for the visit is registered |
| checked in | completed | the visit is completed and documented |
| booked or confirmed | no-show | the patient does not arrive and the appointment is not checked in by the no-show minutes after the start |

## Minute timeline — hypothetical figures

The figures are invented for illustration: a start of 9:00, grace of 10 minutes, no-show marking at 30 minutes and a Riverbend-delay figure of 30 minutes.

| Situation | Judgement | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| The patient arrives at 9:05 | within the 10 grace minutes after the start | the patient is seen |
| The patient arrives at 9:20 | after the grace minutes | handled under the visit type's late-arrival policy |
| No check-in by 9:30; Riverbend was on time | not checked in by the no-show minutes | marked no-show |
| No check-in by 9:30; Riverbend was running 40 minutes late and the patient left | delay of more than 30 minutes and the patient left | recorded as a Riverbend cancellation, not a no-show |
| No check-in by 9:30; Riverbend was running exactly 30 minutes late and the patient left | a delay of 30 minutes is not more than 30 | marked no-show |

## Points of judgement

**Does a Riverbend delay alone prevent the no-show?** The exception requires both that Riverbend was running more than the visit type's Riverbend-delay minutes late and that the patient left; the appointment is then recorded as a Riverbend cancellation instead of a no-show.

**What does check-in do besides changing the status?** It registers the hospital account for the visit.
